description: Na₄TiSe₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four TiSe₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiSe₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-57°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four TiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiSe₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-54°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiSe₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-48°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.24 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.39 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.13 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.14 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with three TiSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-73°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.18 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four Se atoms to form TiSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-62°. There are a spread of Ti-Se bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.43 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to four Se atoms to form TiSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with four NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-68°. There are a spread of Ti-Se bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.44 Å. There are eight inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ti atom. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ti atom. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted pentagonal bipyramidal geometry to six Na and one Ti atom. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ti atom. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the seventh Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom.
